import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set color palette
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1']
sns.set_palette(colors)

# 1. Pairplot-style scatter: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species, color in zip(df['species'].unique(), colors):
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(subset['petal_length'], subset['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=color, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species, color in zip(df['species'].unique(), colors):
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=color, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plot for Petal Length
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', value_vars=['petal_length'], 
                    var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
bp = ax3.boxplot([df[df['species'] == s]['petal_length'] for s in df['species'].unique()],
                  labels=df['species'].unique(), patch_artist=True,
                  boxprops=dict(linewidth=1.5),
                  medianprops=dict(color='darkred', linewidth=2),
                  whiskerprops=dict(linewidth=1.5),
                  capprops=dict(linewidth=1.5))
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Petal Length Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# 4. Violin plot for all measurements
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df_long = df.melt(id_vars='species', 
                  value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                  var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
df_long['measurement'] = df_long['measurement'].str.replace('_', ' ').str.title()
violin_parts = ax4.violinplot([df_long[df_long['measurement'] == m]['value'] 
                                for m in df_long['measurement'].unique()],
                               positions=range(4), showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
for pc in violin_parts['bodies']:
    pc.set_facecolor('#9B59B6')
    pc.set_alpha(0.6)
ax4.set_xticks(range(4))
ax4.set_xticklabels(df_long['measurement'].unique(), rotation=15, ha='right')
ax4.set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Overall Distribution of All Measurements', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
